title: Titan Hammer
description: A legendary custom mace with Wind Launch, Dash Strike, passive buffs, custom crafting, and powerful enchantments. ⚡🔨💨
body:
# Titan Hammer

A powerful custom mace plugin for Minecraft 1.21.x Paper servers.

## Features

🔨 Custom Titan Hammer mace

⚡ Right Click: Wind Launch ability

💨 Shift + Right Click: Dash Strike ability

💪 Passive Strength II while in inventory

🏃 Passive Speed I while in inventory

✨ Built-in enchantments:

* Breach II
* Density V
* Unbreaking III
* Mending I
* Wind Burst I

🛠 Custom crafting recipe using:

* Player Heads
* Enchanted Golden Apples
* Heavy Core
* Breeze Rod

⚙ Fully configurable effects, cooldowns, item name, lore, and abilities.

### Commands 

```
/titans

gives the Titan Hammer
aliases: /th, /thammer
permission: titans.get
/titanrecipe

debug command to check recipe registration
alias: /threcipe
permission: titans.admin (op-only by default)
```

**Perfect for SMPs, PvP servers, events, and content creators.**

**Supported Versions:** 1.21 - 1.21.11
**Loader:** Paper
